relations.text: 年次報告で、AWS・GCP・Azure上でElastic Cloudを提供するため、Amazon、Google、Microsoftと提携していると説明している
relations.text_en: The annual report says it partners with Amazon, Google, and Microsoft to offer Elastic Cloud on AWS, GCP, and Azure

source.label: Elastic 10-K
source.quote: We partner with Amazon, Google, and Microsoft to offer Elastic Cloud on AWS, GCP, and Azure, respectively, through direct purchase from us or their respective marketplaces.

relations.text: Elastic AI Ecosystemに、NVIDIAとの統合が含まれている
relations.text_en: The Elastic AI Ecosystem includes integrations with NVIDIA

source.label: Elastic 10-K
source.quote: The Elastic AI Ecosystem includes integrations with Anthropic's Claude, Cohere, Confluent, Dataiku, DataRobot, Galileo, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Mistral AI, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Protect AI, Red Hat, Vectorize.io, and Unstructured, along with all of the major hyperscalers, consisting of AWS, GCP, and Azure.

relations.text: NVIDIA cuVSとの統合を技術プレビューで導入し、Elasticsearchの索引作成を最大12倍に高速化する
relations.text_en: It introduced NVIDIA cuVS integration in technical preview to accelerate Elasticsearch indexing by up to 12x

source.label: Elastic 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Introduced NVIDIA cuVS integration for GPU-accelerated vector indexing in technical preview, offloading index building to GPUs vs CPUs to accelerate Elasticsearch indexing by up to 12x

relations.text: Elastic AI Ecosystemに、AnthropicのClaudeとの統合が含まれている
relations.text_en: The Elastic AI Ecosystem includes integrations with Anthropic's Claude

source.label: Elastic 10-K
source.quote: The Elastic AI Ecosystem includes integrations with Anthropic's Claude, Cohere, Confluent, Dataiku, DataRobot, Galileo, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Mistral AI, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Protect AI, Red Hat, Vectorize.io, and Unstructured, along with all of the major hyperscalers, consisting of AWS, GCP, and Azure.

relations.text: OpenAIとの協業を発表し、OpenAIの推論モデルをElasticsearch上の企業データと組み合わせる
relations.text_en: It announced a collaboration with OpenAI to bring OpenAI's advanced reasoning models with governed enterprise context in Elasticsearch

source.label: Elastic 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced our collaboration with OpenAI to bring OpenAI’s advanced reasoning models with governed enterprise context in Elasticsearch across AI applications, security operations, and observability

relations.text_en: It collaborated with Dell and Nvidia to power the Dell AI Data Platform with Elasticsearch as the unstructured data engine

companies.name: ハブスポット

relations.text: HubSpotの年次報告が、データ収集・処理の拡張にElasticsearchなどのオープンソース分散システムを使っていると述べている
relations.text_en: HubSpot's annual report says it uses open-source distributed systems including Elasticsearch to scale data collection and processing

source.label: HubSpot 10-K
source.quote: We utilize a variety of open-source distributed systems including HBase, Kafka, Vitess, and Elasticsearch to scale our data collection and processing.
source.note: 製品の利用に関する記載です。

relations.text: HubSpotは、HBase、Elasticsearch、Kafkaなどの分散技術でデータベースを構築したと述べている
relations.text_en: HubSpot says it built its database using distributed technologies such as HBase, Elasticsearch and Kafka

source.label: HubSpot 10-K
source.quote: This is possible because we built our database from the ground up using distributed big data technologies such as HBase, Elasticsearch and Kafka to both process and analyze the large amounts of data we collect.

relations.text: Qualysの年次報告が、同社のクラウド基盤のElasticsearchクラスターで資産の詳細データを検索できると述べている
relations.text_en: Qualys's annual report says its cloud platform's Elasticsearch clusters let customers find detailed data on any asset

source.label: Qualys 10-K
source.quote: Our cloud platform’s powerful Elasticsearch clusters enable customers to instantly find detailed data on any asset.
source.note: 製品の利用に関する記載です。

relations.text: エラスティックの年次報告が、ベクトル検索を統合したデータベース基盤の例としてMongoDB Atlasを挙げている
relations.text_en: Elastic's annual report cites MongoDB Atlas as a database platform with integrated vector search

source.label: Elastic 10-K
source.quote: Apache Solr (open source offering), and Coveo; native vector databases, such as Pinecone, Qdrant, and Weaviate; database platforms with integrated vector search, such as MongoDB Atlas; and search tools, such as Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) and Microsoft Azure AI Search.

relations.text: データドッグの年次報告が、エラスティックを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Elastic as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Datadog 10-K
source.quote: • with respect to Log Management, we compete with Cisco Systems, Inc., and Elastic N.V.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
